resourceProfile.assessment: The complete English and Swedish source scope, review metadata, glossary, and project concept references were available locally.

automatedQuality.summary: Translation review metadata, queue validation, typecheck, 79 test files with 462 tests, complete build, 39 IIS rules with 61 route cases, and 724 generated-link checks passed.

linguisticCritique.summary: A bounded Swedish pass identified 25 actionable terminology, grammar, technical-clarity, heat-flux, SI, and wire-gauge defects across electrical, circuit, thermal, and engineering content; all 25 were corrected.

competentHumanReview.summary: No competent Swedish human review was performed in this cycle; changed IDs remain machine-drafted.

publicationAuthorization.summary: No merge, publication, deployment, or residual-risk authorization was requested or granted.

findings.summary: The current example title used the adjective current instead of the electrical quantity.
evidence: The previous title was Hitta aktuell.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Hitta strömmen.

findings.summary: The electrical-power heading used kraft, meaning force, instead of effekt.
evidence: The previous title was Elektrisk kraft.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Elektrisk effekt.

findings.summary: The power paragraph used utrymme instead of a safety margin and repeated power terminology awkwardly.
evidence: The previous paragraph described thermal capacity and space rather than engineering margin.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with säkerhetsmarginal and natural power wording.

findings.summary: The Joule-heating summary said current transforms resistance into heat rather than electrical energy.
evidence: The previous summary was Hur elektrisk ström förvandlar motstånd till värme.
findings.resolution: Changed it to electrical energy being converted to heat.

findings.summary: The coil setup used bär for electrical current.
evidence: The previous setup said the coil carries 3 A.
findings.resolution: Changed it to a coil conducting 3 A.

findings.summary: The constant-current bullet used awkward Swedish word order.
evidence: The previous bullet began Vid konstant ström fördubblar det dubbla motståndet.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it with a doubling of resistance doubling heating power.

findings.summary: The heating bullet used the English loanword hårdvara.
evidence: The previous text referred to air, liquid, and hardware.
findings.resolution: Changed it to utrustning.

findings.summary: The practical-heating paragraph used physical space instead of a safety margin.
evidence: The previous paragraph instructed the reader to use suitable space.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with a safety-margin warning and clear continuous-current limits.

findings.summary: The KCL heading used nuvarande, meaning current/present, instead of the electrical term.
evidence: The previous title was Kirchhoffs nuvarande lag.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Kirchhoffs strömlag.

findings.summary: The KCL paragraph used aktuella riktningar instead of current directions.
evidence: The previous paragraph used aktuella riktningar before solving.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with strömriktningar and natural node-flow wording.

findings.summary: The series-connection definition omitted the dative form needed for natural Swedish.
evidence: The previous bullet said a series connection gives current only one path.
findings.resolution: Changed it to give the current one path through the components.

findings.summary: The voltage-law paragraph had incorrect Swedish grammar for the algebraic sum of voltage rises and drops.
evidence: The previous sentence began Den algebraiska summan av spänningen stiger och sjunker.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with explicit voltage rises and drops and clearer series-resistance wording.

findings.summary: The series-cell formula localized the protected series note.
evidence: The previous expression ended with (serie).
findings.resolution: Restored the protected (series) notation.

findings.summary: The lithium-ion charging warning used an awkward noun phrase for series charging.
evidence: The previous bullet began Serie litiumjonladdning.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as charging lithium-ion cells in series with cell-level monitoring.

findings.summary: The TCR heading used kraft, meaning force, instead of effekt.
evidence: The previous title was TCR, kraft och praktiska gränser.
findings.resolution: Changed it to TCR, effekt och praktiska gränser.

findings.summary: The TCR current formula omitted spacing around division.
evidence: The previous expression was I = V/R.
findings.resolution: Restored I = V / R.

findings.summary: The heat-flux display name omitted the density/per-area meaning.
evidence: The previous name was Värmeflöde.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Värmeflödestäthet.

findings.summary: The final heat-flux checklist item used an infinitive where a direct imperative was needed.
evidence: The previous text ended with använda värmekapacitet.
findings.resolution: Changed it to use värmekapacitet for the temperature change.

findings.summary: The SI length row used mätare, meaning a gauge or measuring device, instead of the unit metre.
evidence: The previous row used mätare.
findings.resolution: Changed it to meter.

findings.summary: The length-conversion heading used the English word Inches.
evidence: The previous title was Inches och metrisk längd.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Tum och metrisk längd.

findings.summary: The wire-gauge display name used a gauge-reading term rather than wire dimensions.
evidence: The previous name was Trådmätare.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Tråddimensioner: AWG, SWG och BWG.

findings.summary: The gauge-number guidance used awkward and inconsistent gauge terminology.
evidence: The previous bullet used spårtal and spårvidd.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with natural Swedish wording for gauge number and 00/000/0000 sizes.

findings.summary: The AWG formula localized the protected inch variable.
evidence: The previous expression used d_tum.

findings.summary: The wire-resistance formula omitted spaces around division.
evidence: The previous expression was R = ρ × L/A.
findings.resolution: Restored R = ρ × L / A.

findings.summary: The practical wire specification used aktuell kapacitet, which means current/recent capacity rather than current-carrying capacity.
evidence: The previous bullet used aktuell kapacitet.
findings.resolution: Changed it to strömkapaciteten.
